name: Valdemar II of Denmark
contribution: King of Denmark from 1202 until his death in 1241.

checks.lead: Valdemar II Valdemarsen (28 June 1170 – 28 March 1241), later remembered as Valdemar the Victorious (Danish: Valdemar Sejr) and Valdemar the Conqueror, was King of Denmark from 1202 until his death in 1241.
